LanguageData.CargoElevator_CandidatesAvailable: {0} unconnected elevator(s) at this position on other levels. Use "Connect to...".
LanguageData.CargoElevator_ConnectDesc: Link this elevator to an unconnected elevator at the same position on another level. The link cannot be changed afterwards.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_GoToPartnerDesc: Jump to the linked elevator on the other level.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_UnloadDesc: Put everything in this elevator's buffer down nearby. Pawns will haul it to storage.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_UnloadIncomplete: {0}: no room nearby for {1} item stack(s); they stay in the elevator.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_ToggleFifoDesc: On: the buffer is sent strictly in order; if the first entry can't be delivered, everything waits. Off: the first entry that can be delivered is sent.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_ToggleMergeDesc: On: arriving items join any buffered stack of the same kind. Off: every arrival is kept as its own entry.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_ToggleDropDesc: On: items that no storage next to the linked elevator accepts are put down on a free cell next to it. Off: such items wait in this elevator.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_ToggleInsertDesc: On: colonists haul items into this elevator. Off: colonists leave it alone, so it only receives from conveyor belts and other mods. Items already on their way still arrive. Transport loaders are not affected: this elevator still pulls from them.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SlotsDesc: Buffer size in slots. A slot holds one full stack. Currently {0}.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_MsgLoaderUnlinked: Transport loader lost its elevator. Loading continues, but nothing is transferred until you turn "Transfer items to elevator" back on.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_LoaderNeedsLink: The loader is not linked to an elevator. Build it next to one, or use "Connect to...".
LanguageData.CargoElevator_ToggleTransferDesc: On: the linked elevator takes loaded items out of this loader as soon as it has room. Off: loaded items stay here until you unload them.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_LoaderPriorityDesc: When several loaders are linked to one elevator, the elevator takes items from the higher priority loader first.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_LoaderConnectDesc: Link this loader to one of the elevators next to it. The link stays until one of them is removed.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_LoaderPairDown: the elevator is not connected or has no power
LanguageData.CargoElevator_MsgLoaderPawnReturned: {0} could not go through {1}: the elevator is not connected or has no power. Put down next to the loader.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_LoaderUnloadIncomplete: {0}: no room nearby for {1} item stack(s); they stay in the loader.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_LoaderElevatorNotConnected: The linked elevator is not connected to an elevator on another level.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_LoaderOpenMenuDesc: Choose what to send through the elevator: items, people and animals. While an order is in progress, this also changes it.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingsAppliedOnClose: Changes take effect when this window is closed, also for elevators and loaders already built.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingElevatorGlowDesc: When off, elevators give no light. Their green or red lamp still shows their state.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingElevatorEvenGlowDes: The game centres a light on one cell, so a single light on a large elevator sits off-centre and reaches further on one side. When on, a large elevator uses one light per cell instead, centred on the whole elevator and about as bright as the single light on its brighter side. When off, it uses one light: slightly cheaper each time the light changes.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingLoaderGlow: Transport loaders light up their surroundings
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingLoaderGlowDesc: When off, transport loaders give no light. Their orange lamp still shows when they have something to send.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingLoaderBlink: Transport loaders blink while items wait
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingLoaderBlinkDesc: A loader holding items with no order in progress blinks orange. When off, its lamp stays on instead, for as long as items are inside.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingTicksPerStackDesc: The elevator sends one piece (at most one full stack) every this many ticks. 60 ticks are one second at normal speed; fewer ticks means faster transfer.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingMaxSlotsDesc: How many full stacks the elevator can hold while sending. New elevators start with all of them. Elevators already above a lowered maximum keep their slots; they can be reduced but not raised again past the maximum.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingActivePowerDesc: Power drawn at each end while items are being moved.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingIdlePowerDesc: Power drawn at each end while nothing is being moved.
LanguageData.CargoElevator_SettingVerboseLoggingDesc: Writes a line to the log for every transfer, link and state change. Useful for bug reports; slows the game slightly while elevators are busy. Warnings are always logged.
